Option (a)
958749 = (9 + 8 + 4) - (5 + 7 + 9) = 21 - 21 = 0 (hence divisible by 11)

Hence 958749 is divisible by 11.

a3+b3=(a+b)(a2+b2+ab)

260+1 , 220+1 का गुणज है

अत,  260+1, उस पूर्ण संख्या से पूर्णतः विभाज्य है।

If (3x + 1) and (x - 3) both are factors of p2x2 - 12x - q, then

यदि (3x + 1) और (x - 3) दोनों p2x2 - 12x - q के गुणनखंड हैं, तो
questions_hin.s_hi:
3x + 1 = 0

x = -1/3 ... (i)

put value (i) in p2x2 - 12x - q

p2 (-1/3)2 - 12 * (-1/3) - q = 0

p2/9 + 4 - q = 0

p2 + 36 - 9q = 0 .. (ii)

x - 3 = 0

x = 3 .. (iii)

put value (ii) in p2x2 - 12x - q

p2 * 32 - 12 * 3 - q = 0

9p2 - 36 - q = 0 ... (iv)

Add (ii) and (iv)

P2 = q
